newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close lower on continuing correction.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close lower on continuing correction.

text.p: A continuing correction pulled Dhaka shares more than one percent lower by the close, brokers said.
The benchmark index of the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) ended 27.67 points or 1.21 percent down at 2,241.83 on a turnover of 23.1 million taka. Of 71 traded issues, 36 lost and 35 gained.

"Only high-priced shares fell today. I think the market will stabilise in next two weeks if regulators behave rationally and panic in the kerb market goes," said Shahiq Khan, General Secretary of DSE.
Bangladesh Tobacco Co. lost 11 taka to 215 and Monno Fabrics gained 10.87 to 229.19.
